description.en:
LimX Luna is a full-size interactive humanoid built for performances and engagement in commercial spaces, including exhibitions, shopping centres, theme parks and brand events. Introduced in May 2026, it uses LimX's whole-body motion technology to combine expressive movement with a human-scale appearance.

LimX specifies a height of 1.60 metres and 27 degrees of freedom excluding end effectors. Video-based motion learning, a no-code task editor and synchronized multi-robot control are intended to help operators create and reuse performance content. Luna's focus is interactive motion and audience experience; its demonstrated performances should be distinguished from general-purpose industrial manipulation.
